name: Escape From New York: City Under Siege, 31 October 1997
notes: The wing's Halloween pay-per-view, every match staged at a named New York City landmark (Hard Rock Cafe, Yankee Stadium, the Waldorf Astoria, the subway, Ellis Island, Macy's, Broadway), framed by a two-hander in which a well-dressed man and his minder buy twenty-four hours of the city from the Mayor of New York, addressed as 'Rudi' and 'Mr. Mayor' -- an in-fiction portrayal of a real public figure (serves freely, no marker). A reader's own one-line response, posted six days later, is served beside the card at /promotions/hiwf/archive/hiwf-escape-from-new-york-response-1997-11-06.html.
